title: Porches N' Paradise House | KEY.co
description_expanded: Enjoy the refreshing coastal breeze on the spacious deck, or retreat indoors to experience the ultimate comfort of central air conditioning. The open kitchen boasts full-size appliances and ample counter space, making it a breeze to prepare delicious meals. Gather around the island, which also doubles as a convenient breakfast bar, for casual dining and memorable conversations. And if you're in the mood for some outdoor cooking, the provided gas grill on the back deck is at your disposal. As a guest of this home, you'll have exclusive access to a shared outdoor pool, ensuring endless hours of fun and relaxation. Dive in and cool off under the warm sun, or simply lounge by the poolside with a refreshing beverage in hand. And if you're craving the feel of soft sand between your toes, the beach is just a short distance away, allowing you to easily soak up the sun and enjoy the gentle waves.
rooms_guidance: Bedroom 4: Single Over Double Bunk + Single Over Single Bunk + Trundle
